🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive, indicating broad strength, but signals conflict: SPY/TLT is RECOVERY (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.75%, ↑ rising) while HYG/LQD is ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +0.81%, ↑ rising), and the consumer-cycle ratio is in CORRECTION (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +1.22%, ↓ falling).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear is easing short term: VXX (1W: -14.67% | 1M: +9.66%) is in CORRECTION, ↓ falling. Credit stress is easing as HYG/LQD (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +0.81%) is ABOVE TREND, ↑ rising; stocks are rebounding relative to bonds, with SPY/TLT (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.75%) in RECOVERY, ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Dollar strength is firm: Dollar Strength (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +2.01%) is ABOVE TREND, ↑ rising. Duration is weak, with TLT (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -0.32%) BELOW TREND; yields are under upward pressure.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Broad participation, but leadership is mixed: XLF (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%) is ABOVE TREND, while XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%) is in RECOVERY. XLP (1W: +2.52% | 1M: +6.54%) is ABOVE TREND; style is mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US large caps are recovering: SPY (1W: +2.59% | 1M: -2.26%) is in RECOVERY. EEM (1W: +2.68% | 1M: -4.75%) is also in RECOVERY, while China lags: FXI (1W: -4.21% | 1M: -2.28%) is BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Small caps hold up: IWM (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +0.89%) is ABOVE TREND. Speculation remains weak: ARKK (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -12.49%) and IBIT (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -16.42%) are both BELOW TREND.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Metals are weak: GLD (1W: -4.58% | 1M: -7.12%) and CPER (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -7.40%) are BELOW TREND. Gold versus stocks (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -5.86%) is BELOW TREND, ↓ falling.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy is rebounding but remains below its monthly level: XLE (1W: +5.42% | 1M: -2.40%) is in RECOVERY. Natural gas also rebounds: UNG (1W: +8.56% | 1M: -8.48%) is in RECOVERY, while oil remains weak: BNO (1W: -1.86% | 1M: -5.86%) is BELOW TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Broad sector breadth is confirmed at 11/11 positive, but major assets remain in RECOVERY: SPY (1W: +2.59% | 1M: -2.26%) and QQQ (1W: +3.63% | 1M: -6.61%). VXX (1W: -14.67% | 1M: +9.66%) is in CORRECTION, a short-term fear pullback against its monthly rise.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Stay selective within the NEUTRAL regime. XLF (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%) and XLP (1W: +2.52% | 1M: +6.54%) are ABOVE TREND; monitor XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%) and reduce exposure to speculative assets such as ARKK (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -12.49%).

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If broad breadth holds, monitor XLF (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +6.17%), which is ABOVE TREND.
BEARISH: If monthly weakness persists, watch XLK (1W: +3.36% | 1M: -10.00%), which remains in RECOVERY.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If the rebound extends, monitor XLE (1W: +5.42% | 1M: -2.40%), in RECOVERY.
BEARISH: If metals weakness continues, watch SLV (1W: -5.85% | 1M: -15.00%), BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
Reference levels: VIX 18.73 (1W: -1.52% | 1M: +1.90%, ↓ falling, CORRECTION); HYG/LQD 0.7484 (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +0.81%, ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND); SPY/TLT 9.5033 (1W: +3.48% | 1M: -0.75%, ↑ rising, RECOVERY); XLK/XLF 2.9018 (1W: -1.52% | 1M: -12.19%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime; Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive, broad strength amid conflicting signals. Financials and defensives are showing relative strength, while style leadership is mixed. Monitor the gap between broad positive breadth and monthly weakness in SPY and XLK.
